title: API N+1 query storm
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the API component, the deployment‑related problem, and the trigger as the release of version 2.3.2.
root_cause: The deployment of API version 2.3.2 introduced inefficient server-side logic for product listings, causing high database CPU (65%) and slowing API responses to 3-5 seconds.
truth: api 2.3.2 introduced an N+1 query pattern in the product listing: it fetches products with one query, then issues a separate query for each product's category and stock, overwhelming the database with thousands of tiny queries per page load.
check_first: api container logs and database performance metrics
